tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the pages this account can see: its own, then pages other accounts share with it, each with the access it has there (owner, editor or viewer) and how many monitors are on it and down.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List the monitors on every page this account can see, or on one page, with status, page and access. Monitors on a page shared to view have no id; address them by page_id and slug.

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.description: Get one monitor by id, including its ping URL for heartbeat monitors, or by page_id and slug, which also works on a page shared to view.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Create a heartbeat monitor (default) or an HTTP check on the account's first page or on page_id, which may be a page shared with this account as editor. Returns the monitor and, for heartbeats, the ping URL to call after each run.

tools.name: check_in
tools.description: Report on a heartbeat monitor: 'success' after a completed run (resets the deadline), 'start' when a run begins, 'fail' when it failed. Include a short message; it is kept as the run log.

tools.name: pause_monitor
tools.description: Pause a monitor so it stops alerting until resumed or pinged again.

tools.name: resume_monitor
tools.description: Resume a paused monitor.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Which account this key belongs to, its plan's limits and what it uses of them, and what this key may do: its permission on each resource (none, read or write) and the pages it is limited to, if any.

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Change a monitor. Only the fields given change; its kind cannot. Setting cron switches a heartbeat to a cron schedule and setting period switches it back. Only the page's owner can move it, with page_id, to another of their own pages.

tools.name: delete_monitor
tools.description: Delete a monitor and all its history. This cannot be undone; pause_monitor stops alerts without losing anything.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: A heartbeat monitor's newest runs with their outcome, duration, exit code and any model, tokens and cost they reported, plus what its runs cost over 30 days.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: One run with the output it sent (the log), where it came from and what it cost.

tools.name: list_monitor_events
tools.description: One monitor's status changes (up, down, late, paused), newest first.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Status changes across the account's own monitors, newest first.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One page: its public address, monitors and, on your own pages, who it is shared with and as what.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Add a page to group monitors under, within the plan's pages. Its slug is its public address, made from the title when not given.

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Rename one of your pages or change its slug, which moves its public address.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete one of your pages. Only an empty page that is not your first can go.

tools.name: make_page_private
tools.description: Turn off Public on every monitor on one of your pages, which takes its public status page down.

tools.name: share_page
tools.description: Share one of your pages with the account of a person who has a Vivere login (email) or with one of your teams (team_id), as viewer or editor, or change the role they have. Needs a paid plan, a free seat for anybody new, and the Team plan for teams.

tools.name: unshare_page
tools.description: Stop sharing one of your pages with an account (account_id, from get_page) or a team (team_id). Their alert channels come off its monitors.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Your teams, with how many members and pages each has.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: One team: its members and the pages shared with it.

tools.name: create_team
tools.description: Make a team, on the Team plan.

tools.name: rename_team
tools.description: Rename a team.

tools.name: delete_team
tools.description: Delete a team. Its members lose the pages it gave them.

tools.name: add_team_member
tools.description: Add the account of a person with a Vivere login to a team. Joining a team that has pages takes a seat.

tools.name: remove_team_member
tools.description: Take an account out of a team.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: Your alert channels. Secret settings are never shown; secrets_set names the ones that have a value.

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Add an alert channel. Settings by kind: email {to}; webhook {url, secret}; slack {url}; discord {url}; telegram {token, chat_id}; ntfy {url, token}. Slack, Discord, Telegram and ntfy need a paid plan.

tools.name: update_channel
tools.description: Rename a channel or change its settings. Settings left out keep their value.

tools.name: delete_channel
tools.description: Delete an alert channel. Monitors stop sending alerts to it.

tools.name: test_channel
tools.description: Send a test alert to a channel.

tools.name: list_pixels
tools.description: Your tracking pixels, with the tag to paste and how often each has loaded.

tools.name: get_pixel
tools.description: One pixel and its newest loads: when, from which page, browser, language and platform.

tools.name: create_pixel
tools.description: Make a tracking pixel, within the plan's pixels. Returns the tag to paste into a page or an email.

tools.name: delete_pixel
tools.description: Delete a pixel and every load it recorded.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_channels" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_monitor, create_monitor, check_in · Private data: list_runs, make_page_private, list_channels, create_channel · Public sink: list_pages, share_page, create_channel, test_channel, create_pixel · Destructive: create_monitor, check_in, delete_monitor, get_run, delete_page, delete_team, remove_team_member, delete_channel, delete_pixel.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_monitor, create_monitor, check_in · Private data: list_runs, make_page_private, list_channels, create_channel · Public sink: list_pages, share_page, create_channel, test_channel, create_pixel · Destructive: create_monitor, check_in, delete_monitor, get_run, delete_page, delete_team, remove_team_member, delete_channel, delete_pixel

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
